title: Diverse Children in Sunday School Class, 1950s B&W Deckle Edge Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
God's Workers

Roger Wilde
SS

Roger
description: A 1950s black and white snapshot of a group of young children gathered around a dark wooden table in a Sunday school classroom. On the back, handwritten text identifies the group as 'God's Workers' for 'SS' (Sunday School) and mentions 'Roger Wilde'. The kids are wearing classic mid-century clothing, including a young girl with cat-eye glasses, boys in plaid flannel coats, and girl dresses. The background features printed train curtains and airplane art pinned to the wall.
